材质_EN: deer neck and scrolling hand on vase made of ebony;the web is made of yachidamo or shioji.;vase decorated with mother-of-pearl inlay, amber, tortoiseshell, gold leaf and yellow-yellow wood;shrimp tail is made of boxwood.
材质_ZN: 花瓶上的鹿颈和滚动的手，用乌木制成。;腹板是由Yachidamo或Shioji制成。;花瓶装饰有珍珠母镶嵌，琥珀，玳瑁，金箔和黄黄的木头;虾尾是用黄杨木制成的。
描述_EN: A musical instrument listed in the National Treasure Book. The four-stringed lute originated in ancient Persia and is a much-loved instrument in both China and Japan. The back is decorated with mother-of-pearl inlay and tortoiseshell ling.
描述_ZN: 被列入国宝典的乐器。 四弦琵琶起源于古代波斯，在中国和日本都是备受喜爱的乐器。 背面有珍珠母镶嵌和玳瑁陵的装饰。
